notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.notes:
Happy New Year!

I would like to take a moment to thank everyone for your generous support in 2024. Thanks to your positive reviews and word of mouth, this has been Ryclaw Games' best year to date and for that I am immensely grateful. 

I understand that your time and your financial support are a privilege and I will continue to strive to deliver meaningful experiences that are, hopefully, worthy of both. Thank you for supporting my humble efforts to create games that, ideally, leave you a bit better than they find you.

In the age of digital distribution it's easy to forget how incredibly special it is to create something and have another person experience it. It's humbling and touching to realize that these stories that started out as simple ideas in my head have been read by hundreds of people from all over the world. I don't ever want to lose track of how precious a gift that is. Thank you.

I wish for each and every one of you a new year full of blessings and love. Thank you for making 2024 a wonderful year.

Sincerely,
Ryclaw

notes.title: My Little Sister Callie is releasing soon!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the upcoming release of our new game, My Little Sister Callie.

My Little Sister Callie is about a brother helping his little sister to adjust to life outside of a refugee camp. As our longest visual novel to date, a lot of work and love have gone into the title and we hope that shows in the final product. We anticipate that My Little Sister Callie will release within the next two months. We hope you will look forward to experiencing this newest story.

You can find out more information about the game and wishlist it here on its store page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3182390/My_Little_Sister_Callie/

notes.title: Ryclaw: Hope is releasing on October 5th!
notes.notes:
We're pleased to announce that Ryclaw: Hope will be releasing on October 5th with a 30% launch discount.

Since the game has gone through many changes over the course of its development, we have included the description of the game below for your information.

Ryclaw: Hope is a short kinetic novel about a young girl named Sakura who has spent most of her life in the hospital. Coming home for the first time in months, Sakura has a dream that she wants to make a reality. You play as her older brother, who has raised Sakura since the passing of their parents. Spend time with your precocious little sister and help her wish come true.

5 Steam Achievements

15 minute reading time

78 character illustrations

Please keep in mind that Ryclaw: Hope is a very short experience, but we hope it will leave a lasting impression on our readers. We look forward to hearing from you after launch.

Thank you for your patience and support.
Ryclaw Games

notes.title: Ryclaw: Hope nearing release and Steam Achievements
notes.notes:
Ryclaw: Hope is nearing release. While we don't have a firm release date at this time, we are anticipating that we will release in October. We are also pleased to announce that Steam Achievements will be included in the game.

Development of Ryclaw: Hope has been difficult at times. We had to start over with a completely new game engine over halfway into development in order to include the features that are standard for the visual novel genre as well as Steam Achievements. We also changed the vision and visuals of the game, choosing to tell a shorter, more heartfelt story about Sakura, a little girl who refuses to allow her illness to hold her back. Despite our numerous setbacks during development, we are very proud of what Ryclaw: Hope has become and we hope that you will feel the same.

We will announce a release date when the game is completed and cleared by Steam for release. Thank you for your patience and understanding. We will continue to strive to bring you the best game possible.
